# Review notes for the walkthrough

This skill exists so the walkthrough has a real file to watch arrive, change and
disappear again. It is not useful outside that.

## Rules

- Write one note per branch, under the directory the walkthrough answered.
- Sign every note with the agent name the walkthrough answered.
- Link the dashboard the walkthrough answered at the bottom of the note.

The reference beside this file is a template, so it shows what a template can
read, and which file a sibling recipe contributed.
